import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int p, k, answer;
    static boolean[] visited;

    static int compute() {
        answer = 1;
        if (k == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
                answer = (int)((long)answer * p % MOD);
            }
        } else if (k == 1) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= p; ++i) {
                answer = (int)((long)answer * p % MOD);
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
                if (!visited[i]) {
                    int length = 0;
                    int current = i;
                    while (!visited[current]) {
                        visited[current] = true;
                        ++length;
                        current = (int)((long)current * k % p);
                    }
                    if (current != 0) {
                        answer = (int)((long)answer * p % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return answer;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        p = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        visited = new boolean[p];
        System.out.println(compute());
        sc.close();
    }
}
